item.title: Manteca, EU, Lathrop win Buff Collegiate Showcase finales
item.description: Manteca and Los Banos were locked in a scoreless tie for more than 70 minutes Saturday before Adriel Vega took a pass from Julian Oregel for the lone goal of the night in a 1-0 Buffaloes win to wrap up the two-day Buffalo Collegiate Showcase at Guss Schmiedt Field.

item.title: WEEKEND: Calderara, Ripon surge past Stagg for 1st boys basketball win
item.description: Ripon’s boys basketball team got off the schneid Saturday in Tracy, capping the West Tournament with a 59-46 over Stagg in the seventh-place game.

item.title: ROUNDUP: Ripon girls soccer blanks East Union for 7th shutout
item.description: In a final tune-up before the start of the Trans Valley League girls soccer campaign, Ripon blanked host East Union 2-0 on Monday at Woodward Park for its seventh shutout of the season.

item.title: Cornish’s late header catapults Buffs to VOL-opening win at Sierra
item.description: Brooklyn Cornish connected cleanly with a header on Kailee Jackson’s corner kick in the 75th minute, but the shot deflected off a Sierra defender in a back-and-forth Valley Oak League opener Monday at Daniel Teicheira Memorial Stadium. She did waste her next opportunity just two minutes later.

item.title: After spending $100 billion to educate DREAMers, USA, is now deporting them
item.description: Does anyone in Washington understand the value of money? That, of course, is a stupid question.

item.title: 500 plus veterans remembered at East Union Cemetery
item.description: National Wreaths Across America Day was celebrated Saturday in Manteca. Over 500 veterans were remembered, honored, and their graves adorned with a wreath through this initiative.

item.title: College and NFL football standout Paul Wiggin dies
item.description: Paul Wiggin — a Lathrop native who was selected as Manteca High’s Outstanding Athlete when he graduated in 1952 before going on to a storied collegiate football and NFL career — has passed away.

item.title: 339 homeless shelter beds added throughout SJ County since 2021
item.description: Jurisdictions in San Joaquin County have added 339 new homeless shelter beds in the past four years.

item.title: Ripon school board will select president tonight
item.description: For the past year, Jason Winter has served as president of the Ripon Unified school board. He’s the Area 1 Trustee representative.

item.title: COMING IN 2026: DINING ‘IN’ THE LEVEE AT RIVER ISLANDS
item.description: It’s safe to say it will be the only restaurant in California “inside” a levee. But that’s not the only thing that will help make Redwood Café 2.0 arguably the most unique restaurant in the Northern San Joaquin Valley when it opens next year.
